steps.ask: What are the co-ordinates of any point at angle θ on the unit circle?
steps.title: Place P on the unit circle using the angle

lines.text: On the unit circle, a point at angle $\theta$ is $(\cos\theta, \sin\theta)$.

steps.ask: Which quadrant is 300° in, and is cos positive or negative there? What is the related angle?
steps.title: Find the x co-ordinate

lines.text: $\hl{1}{300^\circ}$ is in the fourth quadrant, where cos is positive. The related angle is $\hl{2}{60^\circ}$.

steps.ask: Is sin positive or negative in this quadrant? What size is sin of the related angle?
steps.title: Find the y co-ordinate

lines.text: In the fourth quadrant sin is negative.

problems.note: Only the quadrant changes: 210° is in the third quadrant, where both cos and sin are negative, instead of the fourth. The steps are the same.
